hero: A local repair garage interior: a compact car on a lift, a wheel-balancing machine, a pegboard of wrenches; through a high window, rolling farmland and a small lake in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#2d2c18), accent highlights (#a8e5e6), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers.
